name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Culture_Any_Property
title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Culture Any Property
description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'General culture: Everything by culture technique (upper bound)', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Candidate pool: every observable with a culture technique regardless of property (identity, threshold, colony counts, susceptibility by culture). Upper bound for review. Parts: LOINC enumeration (786, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (2), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 246501002 |Technique (attribute)| = << 703725008 |Culture technique (qualifier value)|`
purpose: Guidance for binding Observation.code of the MII microbiology request profiles to a computably defined LOINC set; accompanies ballot comments on 2027.0.0-ballot2. Generated, not hand-curated.
